newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Blue Star buys two NZ firms.
newsitem.headline: Blue Star buys two NZ firms.

text.p: Blue Star, a unit of U.S. Office Products, said on Tuesday it had bought two New Zealand companies, Auckland-based General Packaging Ltd and Wellington Business Equipment.
General Packaging has annual turnover of NZ$12 million. Besides paper, plastic and other forms of packaging, it sells marine products, protective masks and other products.
Wellington Business Equipment, owned by GAEN Holdings Ltd, is the largest independent supplier of photocopiers in the Wellington region with annual turnover over $3.5 million.
Blue Star has expanded aggressively in New Zealand, with purchases including stationery group Whitcoulls for US$220 million in July.
US Office Products/Blue Star companies in New Zealand and Australia have an annual turnover in excess of NZ$1.4 billion.
